name: JAWAD A. SHAH, M.D., PC, Integrated Hospital Specialists, PC, Insight Anesthesia, PLLC, and Sterling Anesthesia, PLLC, Plaintiffs-Appellees, v. STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE COMPANY, Defendant-Appellant.
name_abbreviation: Jawad A. Shah, M.D., PC v. State Farm Mut. Auto. Ins. Co.
text: On order of the Chief Justice, the motion of defendant-appellant to file a brief addressing the no-fault amendments and responding to the amicus brief of the Michigan Health & Hospital Association is GRANTED. The brief submitted on August 21, 2019, is accepted for filing.
